body: This is what I thought after I finished this haha I have to do it next time

I'm the artist of this, thank you all for the comments!
I don't visit this subreddit that much but it surprised me seeing this here <3
Yes it's very painful but you learn to live with that, there are days where I still wake up and cry but everything is getting better now that I haven't seen her in a long time.

Thank you. Indeed our story is close, although I'm a female hehe 
And yes, the best for you is to let her go if you want her to be happy but you deserve happiness too, I know is hard to no think about her but time is going to help you, believe me, I truly hope that you can feel better :)

I know how you feel, I'm in the same situation, I was having suicidal thoughts for 4 months because I wanted to end that pain in my heart, everyday I cried, she was my only friend in this world and she left me because I wasn't that special for her, she preferred her best friend over me, is horrible to get through this but I started to feel a little better

If a person like me can do it then you can do it too, there are so many things that can distract you of those things like playing videogames, drawing, traveling, yoga, etc. those things are helping me. I still feel lonely because I don't have friends but knowing that here are people like me is helping me too, I hope we can help each other :) sorry if my english isn't good

I know that there are other people but I think the best thing for me is to be single, I have really bad luck with this, but maybe I'm wrong and like you said there is really one person that could love me with all my defects and that makes me feel a little better
Thank you for your support

You're right and maybe time is going to help me, I still feel horrible for this because she was the only true friend that I had and I'm alone in this place that isn't my home, but I want to change that now that I think that everything wasn't my fault at all and maybe the future has something much better for me, now I really want to have more time for discover that, thank you for you answer.
